statement: Every global section class of the actual inherited arithmetic quotient H whose first coordinate class is zero has unique coordinates in 3 times the multiplication-by-3 completion of Q^times, times a full product over j>=0 of Z_3(1) plus Z_3[[1+3Z_3]]. Each annular factor is evaluated by the explicit norm-coherent roots zeta_(3^n) and real units (1-zeta_(3^n))(1-zeta_(3^n)^-1), with actual field norm transition maps and inverse-deck Shapiro action. The raw augmentation projection is (0,nu) in H^1(Q,(3Z_3(1))^2), and the scaled toric map of E46.7 is (0,nu/3).
where_proved: sections/E_global_zero.tex, E.47, formulas E47.1-E47.21 and the accompanying proof; code/e_global_zero.py, code/e_global_zero.out and code/e_global_zero.json
depends_on: E.38 actual arithmetic quotient N -> H and kernels
E.37 actual free Frobenius basis above seven
manuscript_passages: Part E(c),(d), exact metabelian and marked quotient comparisons
notes: The first-coordinate normalization is unique and continuous, using s=-a(c)/2; the residual quotient is ordinary H^1(Q,J).
The centered annular product is an actual Galois-module isomorphism. Terms from j>=k vanish in the positional quotient modulo 3^k; no infinite sum of raw augmentations is taken.
The first factor is explicitly the restricted prime-valuation sequences with the inverse-limit topology. It is not treated as compact.

The norm limit is evaluated, not left as a named cohomology group: valuations away from 3 vanish; the 3-primary class groups vanish by the one-ramified-prime ambiguous formula; real circular-unit index is prime to 3; actual norms give Z_3(1) plus the completed group ring.
The inverse-deck convention is proved by the cochain identity E47.12. Direct deck translation corresponds to inverse natural field action.
The free-P calculation independently gives B^2/diag(7S7-1) = B plus Z_3, and proves annular classes are unramified outside 3 and compact in their cochain quotient topology.
The section set belongs to the explicitly stated target H of N/N'' and N/gamma_3(I_marked), with kernels displayed in E47.8; no surjectivity on section sets of those intrinsic maps is asserted.
Exact finite checks cover 40 real-unit identities, conjugate norms through conductor 81, five centered positional decompositions, and five finite free-P cokernels with all transition maps.
